"""Exact integer max-flow / min-cut (Dinic) used by the reservation compiler.

Capacities are arbitrary precision Python ints.  The graph keeps a pristine
copy of every arc capacity so a flow computation can be undone cheaply, which
matters because the compiler issues a very large number of probe flows.
"""

BIG = 1 << 400


class FlowGraph:
    __slots__ = ('n', 'to', 'cap', 'src', 'adj', 'dirty', 'mark', 'stamp')

    def __init__(self, n=0):
        self.n = n
        self.to = []
        self.cap = []
        self.src = []
        self.adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        self.dirty = []
        self.mark = []
        self.stamp = 0

    # ---- construction -------------------------------------------------
    def add_node(self):
        self.adj.append([])
        self.n += 1
        return self.n - 1

    def add_arc(self, u, v, c):
        i = len(self.to)
        to = self.to
        cap = self.cap
        src = self.src
        mark = self.mark
        adj = self.adj
        to.append(v)
        cap.append(c)
        src.append(c)
        mark.append(0)
        adj[u].append(i)
        to.append(u)
        cap.append(0)
        src.append(0)
        mark.append(0)
        adj[v].append(i + 1)
        return i

    def set_cap(self, i, c):
        self.src[i] = c
        self.cap[i] = c

    def bump_cap(self, i, delta):
        self.src[i] += delta
        self.cap[i] += delta

    # ---- flow ---------------------------------------------------------
    def _restore(self):
        cap = self.cap
        src = self.src
        for i in self.dirty:
            cap[i] = src[i]
        self.dirty.clear()

    def maxflow(self, s, t, want_cut=False):
        """Return max flow value; if want_cut also return reachable set."""
        to = self.to
        cap = self.cap
        adj = self.adj
        n = self.n
        mark = self.mark
        self.stamp += 1
        stamp = self.stamp
        dirty = self.dirty
        flow = 0
        level = [-1] * n
        it = [0] * n
        while True:
            for i in range(n):
                level[i] = -1
                it[i] = 0
            level[s] = 0
            q = [s]
            head = 0
            while head < len(q):
                u = q[head]
                head += 1
                nu = level[u] + 1
                for i in adj[u]:
                    if cap[i] > 0:
                        v = to[i]
                        if level[v] < 0:
                            level[v] = nu
                            q.append(v)
            if level[t] < 0:
                break
            lt = level[t]
            while True:
                # iterative blocking-flow DFS
                stack_u = [s]
                stack_e = []
                f = BIG
                u = s
                found = False
                while True:
                    if u == t:
                        found = True
                        break
                    adv = False
                    au = adj[u]
                    lu = level[u] + 1
                    while it[u] < len(au):
                        i = au[it[u]]
                        v = to[i]
                        if cap[i] > 0 and level[v] == lu:
                            stack_e.append(i)
                            stack_u.append(v)
                            if cap[i] < f:
                                f = cap[i]
                            u = v
                            adv = True
                            break
                        it[u] += 1
                    if adv:
                        continue
                    level[u] = -1
                    if not stack_e:
                        break
                    u = stack_u.pop()
                    stack_e.pop()
                    it[u] += 1
                if not found:
                    break
                # augment by f
                for i in stack_e:
                    cap[i] -= f
                    j = i ^ 1
                    cap[j] += f
                    if mark[i] != stamp:
                        mark[i] = stamp
                        dirty.append(i)
                    if mark[j] != stamp:
                        mark[j] = stamp
                        dirty.append(j)
                flow += f
                # rewind stack for next augmenting path
                if not stack_e:
                    continue
                u = stack_u[-1]
                while stack_e and cap[stack_e[-1]] == 0:
                    e = stack_e.pop()
                    uu = stack_u.pop()
                    it[uu] += 1
                    u = uu
                # trim stack to the last saturated arc
                if stack_e:
                    # keep prefix up to (but excluding) the last arc if saturated
                    pass
        if want_cut:
            reach = [False] * n
            reach[s] = True
            q = [s]
            head = 0
            while head < len(q):
                u = q[head]
                head += 1
                for i in adj[u]:
                    if cap[i] > 0:
                        v = to[i]
                        if not reach[v]:
                            reach[v] = True
                            q.append(v)
            self._restore()
            return flow, reach
        self._restore()
        return flow
